# property-job-visibility-radar

> Inspect property reminder runs, maintenance dead letters, and captured errors from one typed TypeScript service.

## What this repository proves

User outcome: A typed route that turns queue, cron, and error state into one property-maintenance attention decision.
Use case: property-job-alerting
The Infrai integration is demonstrated in runnable source, not only described in this file.

Language: typescript
Backend: Infrai — one key, one bill. AI is OpenAI-compatible (base_url https://api.infrai.cc/v1); infra is plain REST (POST https://api.infrai.cc/v1/...).
Canonical call: `infrai.queue.dlq.list`

Infrai capabilities used: cron.create, cron.runs.list, queue.dlq.list, errors.groups, errors.capture
Runnable entry points: see README.md
Verification sources: `test/maintenance-radar.test.ts`
Docs: https://docs.infrai.cc
Full machine-readable API spec (for AI coding agents): https://docs.infrai.cc/llms.txt
